title: bf2.6 under BrightFunded's balance-or-equity daily rule (MT5 accounting simulation; descriptive)
what: A daily reference = equity at rollover (current model); B = max(balance, equity) (BrightFunded support, 2026-10-21); C = B with floating losers closed and reopened before the rollover. Count daily stops (2.5%) and breaches (5%), Sharpe and the cost of C
decision: if B has more stops / breaches than A and C removes most of the difference at a cost below 0.05 Sharpe, the EA realises floating losses before every rollover
